name: Airfoil Self-Noise Aerodynamic Benchmark Dataset
description: The Airfoil Self-Noise dataset consists of 1,503 aerodynamic wind tunnel test measurements conducted by NASA on NACA 0012 airfoil blade sections. Featuring 5 continuous physical predictors (frequency, angle of attack, chord length, free-stream velocity, suction displacement thickness) to predict scaled sound pressure level in decibels.

verification.notes: Verified against UCI Machine Learning Repository dataset 291 (DOI: 10.24432/C5VW2C) and NASA Reference Publication 1218.

size.notes: Whitespace/tab-separated table with 5 input features and 1 continuous sound pressure level target.
